posts: Profiled my contract's hot path this morning: a keyed lookup was scanning a 600-entry Vec. Swapped in LookupMap and read gas fell from ~14 to ~4 TGas. Measure before you optimize. #rust #near
Indexed my contract events into a read model this week. Historical queries went from ~2s of RPC paging to ~90ms. NEAR handles the write path; the read path is on you. #fastdata #near

replies.text: What did you deploy? If it's a contract, post the gas per call — that's the part of ship-it posts I actually learn from.
